name: slider
title: Slider
description: Volume, brightness, zoom, and price ranges.

motionProfile.reason: The native thumb stays on Base UI input geometry, a decorative face owns the press scale, and each track, range and thumb part owns one scoped palette; value input and a readout stay immediate.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: Slider owns one opacity entrance on a later-inserted root with already-correct value geometry; a presenting parent, a hidden host or an unusable control keeps native paint.

feedback.press/one-shot.reason: The decorative thumb face owns the press scale while the native positional layer keeps its coordinate box, hit target and focus ring unscaled.

state.color/css-transition.reason: The track, the range, the thumb ring and the thumb face each own one scoped paint set; real DOM focus or invalid state settles that owner's declared paint immediately in every mode.
